module: JUnit XML test result writer for the xlsxlib tests. Builds a DOM (testsuites > testsuite > testcase, with a failure element for each failed test) then serializes it and writes it with writeFile. Used by libs/xlsxlib/tests/TestManager.
notes: The file requires `libs/slaxml/slaxml` (not slaxdom) but calls `SLAXML:xml`, which is only defined by slaxdom; this works only if slaxdom has already been loaded somewhere (it is, via xlsxlib). In isolation, the call would fail.
The suite name is fixed to "LuaUnitTests". Failed tests have type "ExpectedFailure" if the test was supposed to fail, otherwise "Failure".

write.desc: Writes the results to a JUnit XML file (indentation 2) and logs the path.

results.desc: {testResults = {{name, duration, passed, expectedToFail, errorMessage}}, testFailCount, totalDuration}.

outputFile.desc: Path of the XML file to write (writeFile).
